-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/g2dep

go 1.27

-- dep/g2d/g2d.go --
package g2d

import (
	"reflect"
	"unsafe"
)

type Cell struct{ N int }
type Host struct{ Data []byte }

func (c *Cell) Tap(b []byte) { b[0] = byte(c.N); c.N = 99 }
func MethodValue(c *Cell, b []byte) {
	f := c.Tap
	f(b)
}

type Box2 struct {
	Data []byte
	Fn   func()
}

var slot *Box2

func NewBox2(b []byte) *Box2 { return &Box2{Data: b} }
func ArmFn(h *Box2)          { h.Fn = func() { h.Data[0] = 95 }; slot = h }
func CallFn(h *Box2)         { h.Fn() }

func Inside(b []byte) []byte { b[0] = 93; return []byte{1, 2, 3} }
func LenWrap(b []byte) int   { return len(Inside(b)) }
func MinWrap(b []byte) int   { return int(min(Inside(b)[0], 3)) }

func Tagged(xs ...[]byte) { xs[1][0] = 61 }

func ReflectRead(b []byte) int {
	return len(reflect.ValueOf(b).Slice(0, 1).Interface().([]byte))
}

// SAFETY: the pointer aliases the caller's slice, which stays live for
// the whole call; only the address is taken.
func UnsafeAddr(b []byte) uintptr { return uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])) }

func SumOnly(b []byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}
func ReadPtr(h *Host) int  { return len(h.Data) }
func LenOnly(b []byte) int { return len(b) }
func GoLen(b []byte)       { done := make(chan bool); go func() { _ = LenOnly(b); done <- true }(); <-done }
func GotoSkip(b []byte) {
	goto end
	b[0] = 81
end:
}
func FallIt(b []byte, k int) {
	switch k {
	case 0:
		b[0] = 82
		fallthrough
	case 1:
		b[1] = 83
	}
}
func CpyAsSrc(dst []byte, src []byte) { copy(dst, src) }

-- imp/go.mod --
module example.com/g2imp

go 1.27

require example.com/g2dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/g2dep => ../dep

-- imp/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/g2dep/**"]

-- imp/mvcell/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	cell := g2d.Cell{N: 3}
	buf := []byte{1}
	var cv const *g2d.Cell = &cell
	g2d.MethodValue(cv, buf)
	println(buf[0], cell.N)
}

-- imp/fncall/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1}
	bx := g2d.NewBox2(buf)
	g2d.ArmFn(bx)
	var cv const *g2d.Box2 = bx
	g2d.CallFn(cv)
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/lenwrap/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1}
	var view const []byte = buf
	println(g2d.LenWrap(view))
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/minwrap/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1}
	var view const []byte = buf
	println(g2d.MinWrap(view))
	println(buf[0])
}
